source: ライデン (重装ガンシップ) の船内改修用。ユーザー提供の画像 (2026-11)。通路と前室
style: Interior of a heavy gunship spacecraft in a grounded, worn military style: dark gunmetal, red accent lights, scuffs and stencils. PICTURE cells: ONE item or wall section seen exactly straight on (or from directly above), filling the cell, flat even light, no readable text, letters, numbers or logos. Tiles are flat, evenly lit and seamless.

cells.name: rd-corridor-wall
cells.prompt: Gunship corridor wall: dark gunmetal panels with rivets, a stencilled red stripe and scuffs at shoulder height.

cells.name: rd-corridor-floor
cells.prompt: Gunship corridor floor: dark metal grating over a lit sub-floor, worn yellow edge lines, from above.

cells.name: rd-corridor-ceil
cells.prompt: Gunship corridor ceiling seen from below: pipes and cable trays with a long red-white light strip.

cells.name: rd-hatch-floor
cells.prompt: A round floor hatch with a recessed wheel handle and yellow-black ring, seen from directly above.

cells.name: rd-pipe-wall

cells.name: rd-ready-board

cells.name: rd-emergency-locker

cells.name: rd-deck-marking
